sg_warden.text: The Norwegian church. The whalers had no chaplain for a while, so the station manager read the service himself and kept it short. The wind kept it shorter.

That's the bell outside: ring it for Shackleton, if you like. His funeral service was held here in 1922, in a high wind and a bad temper, from what I hear. A good send-off for a man who liked weather.
